note: Shaped like an A2A agent card so agents can discover ServiceReady. Not a certified A2A implementation: agents reach this seller over MCP (Streamable HTTP), not A2A JSON-RPC.
name: Maya Rao Studio — ServiceReady booking agent
description: Book Maya Rao Studio (freelance brand design) through any MCP client. Paste-a-rate-card storefront: catalog prices are HMAC-signed, agents cannot invent or tamper with amounts. Create a spend-limited payment mandate, request a quote from published services, then mint a PayPal deposit approval link inside that mandate. Deposits are real PayPal sandbox Orders (CAPTURE or AUTHORIZE). Returning clients can Vault PayPal to the mandate for buyer-absent rebooking, still capped and revocable.

skills.name: List catalog services
skills.description: Published packages with catalog price, deposit %, and lead time. Amounts come only from the seller's rate card.
examples: What logo packages do you offer?

skills.name: Request a quote
skills.description: Create a quote for a named client. Totals and deposit are catalog-priced and HMAC-signed; agents cannot pass a price.
examples: Quote the Full Brand Kit for Sam, sam@example.com

skills.name: Create / revoke a spend-limited mandate
skills.description: Hard USD spend limit + revocable key required before minting any PayPal deposit link.

skills.name: Mint PayPal deposit link
skills.description: Create (or reuse) a PayPal Orders v2 deposit order inside the mandate and return the buyer approval URL. The agent never pays on the client's behalf.

skills.name: Vault PayPal for rebooking
skills.description: save_paypal_for_mandate → pay_deposit_with_saved_paypal. Still capped by the mandate and revocable.
examples: Save PayPal to this mandate for next time

skills.name: Read cancellation policy
skills.description: Structured free-cancel window and keep-% rules. Quote verbatim; the server enforces with PayPal void / partial capture / refund.

auth.notes: Public sandbox demo MCP — no API key. Money moves only after a human approves PayPal checkout (or a Vault token the human saved). Agents need a create_payment_mandate key before create_deposit_link.
